derivation: results/h2/H2-A-01/README.md, results/h2/H2-A-01/outcome.json, this file and docs/learning/h2/phase-a-r2/H2-A-01-HUMAN-RUN-AUTHORIZATION.md are [AGENT] records written from the private source records listed here, after each digest was checked
the guard reason, the answer and the question are copied verbatim from the stop disposition and the reply record; the question keeps its typographic characters
the disposition facts are taken from the stop disposition as originally written, not from the later overwritten version

the timeline times are those recorded in the private source records, except that the driver-schema authorization record's preparation time is its file modification time, because no time is recorded inside it; the refusal time was not exposed
redaction: no absolute or private paths, user or host names, emails, or session, task, pane or agent-instance identifiers
private records are cited by description and SHA256 only
the interpreter, prefix, runs root, environment values and wrapped command of the machine binding are not published; the public run proposals give the invocation in placeholder form
no raw directory is published: no run output exists

integration_files_changed.note: the manifest binds this file's digest, so only its original digest is recorded here; its new digest is bound later in a private closure record

new_files.note: their digests are recorded only in the export manifest, so that no digest cycle arises

limits: the original stop disposition is identified by its SHA256; a later private version at the same location was overwritten and is superseded by a disclosure record; it is not used as a source
the stop direction was delivered twice; both deliveries were reporting-only and neither delivered a launch or engine command; the count of run invocations is zero
no run took place: nothing about the engine, the sandbox profile or the engine environment was observed
the driver-schema authorization record is checked by bytes and fields only and cannot show that a person authorized anything
this record authorizes nothing and does not carry the authorization forward
